mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_session_internal_events ( external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, code_session_external_id, sequence_num, event_type, payload_uuid, agent_id, is_compaction, payload, payload_blob_uuid, payload_hash, idempotency_key, event_metadata, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.CodeSessionUUID}, #{params.CodeSessionExternalID}, #{params.SequenceNum}, #{params.EventType}, #{params.PayloadUUID}, #{params.AgentID}, #{params.IsCompaction}, CAST(#{params.Payload,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.PayloadBlobUUID}, #{params.PayloadHash,sensitive=true}, #{params.IdempotencyKey}, CAST(#{params.EventMetadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (workspace_uuid, idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key <> '' AND deleted_at IS NULL DO NOTHING RETURNING

e.created_at < #{query.Cutoff} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_session_internal_events boundary WHERE boundary.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND boundary.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND boundary.code_session_uuid = e.code_session_uuid AND boundary.agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.agent_id AND boundary.deleted_at IS NULL AND boundary.is_compaction AND boundary.sequence_num > e.sequence_num)

e.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcript_archives a WHERE a.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND a.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND a.code_session_uuid = e.code_session_uuid AND a.state <> 'deleting' AND e.sequence_num BETWEEN a.from_sequence_num AND a.to_sequence_num)
mapper.select: SELECT cs.organization_uuid, cs.workspace_uuid, cs.uuid AS code_session_uuid, cs.external_id AS code_session_external_id FROM code_sessions cs WHERE true AND cs.uuid > #{query.AfterUUID} AND AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_session_internal_events e WHERE e.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND e.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND e.code_session_uuid = cs.uuid AND AND ) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM transcript_archives a WHERE a.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND a.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND a.code_session_uuid = cs.uuid AND a.state <> 'deleting')) ORDER BY cs.uuid LIMIT #{query.Limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE code_session_internal_events SET deleted_at = now() WHERE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_session_internal_events e JOIN code_sessions cs ON cs.uuid = e.code_session_uuid AND cs.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND cs.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid WHERE e.uuid = code_session_internal_events.uuid AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.uuid = cs.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND (s.archived_at < #{batch.Eligibility.Cutoff} OR s.deleted_at < #{batch.Eligibility.Cutoff}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_sessions active WHERE active.session_uuid = s.uuid AND active.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND active.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid AND (active.worker_lease_expires_at >= now() OR active.worker_status <> 'idle'))) AND e.created_at < #{batch.Eligibility.Cutoff} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM code_session_internal_events boundary WHERE boundary.organization_uuid = e.organization_uuid AND boundary.workspace_uuid = e.workspace_uuid AND boundary.code_session_uuid = e.code_session_uuid AND boundary.agent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.agent_id AND boundary.deleted_at IS NULL AND boundary.is_compaction AND boundary.sequence_num > e.sequence_num))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM code_session_internal_events WHERE AND deleted_at < #{batch.Cutoff}
